basic_details.post_name: SENIOR RESIDENT (Orthopedic Oncology in the Department of Surgical Oncology)
basic_details.short_information: Tata Memorial Centre (TMC) invites applications from Indian Nationals for the post of SENIOR RESIDENT in Orthopedic Oncology in the Department of Surgical Oncology up to 31st July 2027. Applicants must possess MS/DNB (Orthopedics) and meet the upper age limit of 40 YEARS. Eligible candidates can attend the walk-in interview on 10.11.2026 by reporting between 09:30 A.M. to 10:30 A.M. at Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam, Pincode:-530053. faq.question: Q1. What is the walk-in interview date for TMC Senior Resident recruitment?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held on 10.11.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the reporting time for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must report between 09:30 A.M. to 10:30 A.M.

faq.question: Q3. Where is the interview venue located?
faq.answer: The venue is Homi Bhabha Cancer Hospital & Research Centre, Aganampudi Gajuwaka Mandalam, Visakhapatnam, Pincode:-530053.

faq.question: Q4. What is the essential qualification required for the Senior Resident post?
Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The age limit is 40 years, with relaxations of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC, and 10 years for Physically Handicapped candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly remuneration offered?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 1,33,623/- p.m. (Gross Pay).

faq.question: Q7. What is the tenure for the post?
Q8. What documents must candidates bring to the interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must bring a detailed resume, a recent passport size photograph with attested copies of all qualification & experience certificates, all original educational and experience certificates, and an NOC through the Head of their Institution if working in Central / State Government / Autonomous Body / Semi Government Organizations.
